name: Neural Bundle Adjustment with Dual-Filter Matching
definition: A bundle adjustment technique that refines 3D point cloud, camera intrinsics, and extrinsics using 2D matching points filtered by confidence scores from DUSt3R and ROMA to ensure accurate epipolar geometric constraints.
summary: Neural Bundle Adjustment with Dual-Filter Matching refines 3D point clouds and camera poses using DUSt3R and ROMA confidence filtering, explicitly optimizing geometry rather than radiance fields.
